rule_explanation: protocol §2 Rule A: random main commit in cutoff window [release N - 120d, release N - 60d]. N = latest release at selection time (3.1.3, 2026-02-19). PRNG = mulberry32(sha256(seed).readUInt32LE(0)), same construction as sample-selector.js, seed namespaced per case.
future_window_note: protocol §5b fixed observation window T0 -> T0+120d (issues/PRs/commits/release notes only).
